about: What a release image's build may take beside its one server bundle, read by packages/server/test/image-build.ts and nowhere else. ops/docker is a control path, so a new entry is the owner's change. Each copy is one COPY a release stage may take from a stage that holds the repository, word for word, with --from its only flag; that stage's last instruction is a RUN whose last step is node ops/docker/harness-scan.mjs over exactly the copy's source, so every copy the release stage takes is scanned. Each pre-script is a command pnpm may run before an image's build script, byte for byte; the real-bundle tests replay it before the build and check that the bundle used the file it writes.

copies.reason: The database's files of every package (bootstrap, migrations and grants), read-only at FIN_DB_ASSETS_DIR for the api image's migrate service: exactly the set packages/db/src/assets.ts finds, staged by packages/db/src/assets-cli.ts.

preScripts.reason: The audit event index (AUDIT_EVENTS), generated from packages/audit's fragments and ignored by git: the api's bundle imports it, so its build:server writes it first.
